site_name: Gumley House Convent School For Girls
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces (including a sample of double glazing) hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 109-100-01 B, 109-100-02 A, 109-101 C, 109-102 B, 109-110 B, 109-111 B
Received 4th October 2011
109-201 C, 109-202 E, 109-210 D, 109-212 D, 109-214 D, 109-215 E, 
Received 14th February 2012  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - There should be no demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until details of, in the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands which are to be retained to show the historical past of the building have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the approved plans, details of the proposed glazed internal partitions, solid internal partitions (including archive storage), external timber enclosure for the condenser unit and replacement of an existing window with a heat exchanger inlet and outlet shall be submitted by the consent holder to the Local Planning Authority and approved prior to the commencement of works and the works carried out in accordance with the details so approved.
description: Erection of internal partitions to North-East wing, restore all existing windows, external works including new low level louvered timber enclosure and the replacement of one window with vents for new heat exchange systems
